_doc: BYOM (bring-your-own-model) config. Copy this file to config.json (gitignored) and fill it in. SERVARI never ships a key.

_notes.provider: A label for your own reference (e.g. 'openai', 'anthropic', 'ollama', 'openrouter'). The chat backend speaks the OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions shape, which most providers (and Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, OpenRouter, Together, etc.) expose.
_notes.base_url: The provider's API base. Examples — OpenAI: https://api.openai.com/v1 · Ollama (local): http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 · OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 · LM Studio (local): http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1
_notes.model: The model id at that provider (e.g. 'gpt-4o-mini', 'llama3.1:8b', 'meta-llama/llama-3.1-8b-instruct').
_notes.api_key_env: Preferred secret source. If this environment variable exists, SERVARI uses it before api_key.
_notes.api_key: Write-only fallback for local config.json. Leave empty for keyless local servers (Ollama / LM Studio). The settings API never returns this value.
_notes.backend: auto, api, codex, claude, hermes, or openclaw. auto prefers a configured API, then runnable local CLIs.
_notes.workspace_home: Optional local workspace for CLI providers. If it contains AGENTS.md, the harness boots from that file. Keep private paths in your local config.json or SERVARI_WORKSPACE_HOME, never in source.
_notes.cli: Codex and Claude have built-in one-shot runners. Hermes/OpenClaw default to their non-interactive local CLI modes and can be customized with one_shot_args.
